# wadakatu - Backend Developer Portfolio

> Personal portfolio website for wadakatu, a backend developer based in Japan. Currently working at Studio Inc. building no-code website builders. Active open source contributor to the Laravel ecosystem.

---

## Overview

This is the personal portfolio website of wadakatu, a backend developer specializing in PHP and the Laravel framework. The site serves as a central hub for showcasing professional work, open source contributions, and technical expertise.

### Professional Background

- **Current Role**: Backend Developer at Studio Inc.
- **Location**: Japan
- **Specialization**: PHP, Laravel, API Development
- **Focus Areas**: No-code/low-code platforms, developer tooling, API documentation

### Core Competencies

1. **Backend Development**: Building scalable server-side applications with PHP and Laravel
2. **API Design**: RESTful API architecture and OpenAPI documentation
3. **Open Source**: Active contributor to the Laravel ecosystem
4. **Developer Experience**: Creating tools that improve developer productivity

## Site Technical Details

### Technology Stack

- **Astro 5**: The production site is an Astro project with a static build
- **Hosted on**: GitHub Pages at https://www.wadakatu.dev/
- **Design system**: TOMBO (`/styles/tombo.css` and site styles)
- **Feeds and sitemap**: RSS (`/feed.xml`), Atom (`/atom.xml`), and the Astro sitemap at `/sitemap-index.xml`

### Accessibility features present in the site

- Skip link for keyboard navigation
- ARIA labels and landmarks on the production layouts
- Focus indicators for keyboard users
- Reduced-motion handling in the design system
- Semantic HTML structure

### SEO & AI Optimization

- JSON-LD structured data (Person, ProfilePage, ItemList, and article schemas)
- Open Graph and Twitter Card meta tags (`og:locale` follows the page language)
- This llms.txt / llms-full.txt pair for AI crawlers, linked from robots.txt
